evidence.name: Screen field: Roundness of the button corners
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Roundness of the button corners" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Roundness of the button corners
sections.description: Rounds all four corners of the purchase button by the same amount, from sharp to fully rounded (0-50). The default of about 12 gives a softly rounded look; raise it toward 50 for a pill-shaped button, or set 0 for crisp square corners. Match it to your other buttons so the paywall feels cohesive.
